limitations: The demo record file source scans deploy/evidence and compat/<application>/demo at render time (readdirSync — the file-evidence-store precedent); on a deployment surface without the repository tree (a serverless bundle) the honest fixture-only projection renders — the source is absent, never wrong.

The demo-run service requires the record's discovered inventory for certification-grade authorization (a null inventory stays the INVENTORY_MISSING hard coverage defect, exactly as the PPR-017 assessment discipline demands); work orders must record their inventory alongside the record (the discoveredInventory sibling field of the evidence document — the file source extracts and validates it).

The run-level egress observation the demo-run outcome carries comes from the pinned runtime's own certified environment (the driver composes the harness's Zeck-only egress control); the demo-run service records it verbatim and names passing violations in the run's reason — it does not re-wrap the driver's internals (the ACR-007 split: the driver owns its runtime composition).

The credential erasure gate audits the env-var NAMES the proof environment configures (15 by default); an application with an exotic credential name not on the list is the work order's responsibility to declare (the list is extensible by configuration, never by domain edit).

The port-aware allowlist matches the full host or the port-stripped hostname; a genuinely malicious same-hostname-different-port service on an allowlisted host would pass the host check (the proof environment's loopback is its own trusted infrastructure — the same trust boundary the PPR-017 egress harness assumes).
